text: # GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Both are capped at 40 because `robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site (a blocker on GEO-009). All of these results are read from code, not measured on a live site. Three things hold the score down: Google is blocked from the whole site, pages are drawn only in the browser, and a few head basics are missing. All three are small changes. This report assumes you want search and AI search tools to find this site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Googlebot can't read any page, including the ones in your sitemap and nav. This is a site-wide block that also sends mixed signals against your sitemap. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small (delete the Googlebot group, or change it to `Allow: /` if the block was a mistake) - **Score after this:** 72/100 (Good). It fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 (+6 points) and lifts the cap: 18 ÷ 25. ### 2. Render pages on the server - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers read only the first HTML the server sends. With `ssr = false`, that HTML is an empty shell, so your headings, text and nav links aren't in it. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small (remove it, or set `export const prerender = true;`) - **Score after this:** 84/100 once item 1 is done (21 ÷ 25). On its own it would still be capped at 40 while Googlebot is blocked. ### 3. Add `lang` and fill in the empty shop description - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells machines the page language. An empty description gives them nothing to show for `/shop`. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small (use `` and write a real description) - **Score after this:** 92/100 once items 1 and 2 are done (23 ÷ 25). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt`, plain text with valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have access | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:4-5`, Googlebot `Disallow: /` | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked routes are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are both blocked for Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5`. `/search` is noindex on purpose and isn't in the sitemap or nav, so I left it out. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on the site's domain | Clear | Not run | `/` and `/shop` have absolute canonicals on `quay.example`. `/search` has none but is noindex. | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, `ssr = false` with no prerender (all 3 routes) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`, a Product with only `name` and no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating` | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is discoverable | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid and `static/robots.txt:7` has an absolute `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | Not run | No `lang` at `src/app.html:2`. Empty description at `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3`.
